newsitem.title: UK: Rotterdam bunker market flat, avails plentiful.
newsitem.headline: Rotterdam bunker market flat, avails plentiful.

text.p: Rotterdam bunker fuel prices were little changed in quiet Monday trade with supplies plentiful, dealers said.
"Demand is poor but as soon as demand picks up we should be able to make a dollar or two...It's typical Monday trade," one dealer said.
Rotterdam 380 cst bunker fuel was quoted at $86 a tonne and 180 cst at $92, with Antwerp prices about $1 higher.
Hamburg was even quieter, with one dealer complaining that he had "not heard even one enquiry that looked workable...It's a dead market."
He put Hamburg 380 cst at $91/92 and 180 cst at $97/98.
Demand in the Mediterranean was lacklustre with no shortage of product, dealers said.
Fos 380 cst was quoted at $95 and 180 cst at $101, with Augusta prices about $1 lower, while little business was reported at Piraeus.
